sources.quote: HD 102956 b or Isagel is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2010 by a team of American astronomers led by John Johnson using Doppler spectroscopy and the Keck Observatory in Hawaii.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.5 solar radii and 1.55 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,944 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
